column3: “Someone will take away” is rendered “they will take you away,” “barbs” “meat hooks,” and “posterity” “the last of you.”
NASB supplies “in the walls” and “straight”; “you will throw to Harmon” is rendered “you will be cast to Harmon.” The meaning of “Harmon” is uncertain.
“Increase to transgress” is rendered “multiply transgression”; “to the morning … to three days” is rendered “every morning … every three days.”
“Make smoke” is rendered “Offer”; “make them heard” is rendered “make them known,” and “people of Israel” “sons of Israel.”
“You did not return” is rendered “you have not returned.”
NASB renders the past forms as habitual (“I would send rain”), and adds “furthermore.”
“You did not return” is rendered “you have not returned.”
“Blight” is rendered “scorching wind,” and “the locust” “the caterpillar”; NASB reads “many” as “Your many gardens.”
“Pestilence” is rendered “plague”; “with the capture of your horses” is rendered “along with your captured horses.”
“Among you” is rendered “you”; “a piece of firewood plucked out” is rendered “a firebrand snatched.”
“Consequence for this” is rendered “Because I shall do this to you.”
“Thought” is rendered “thoughts,” capitalized as “His thoughts”; NASB renders “dawn darkness” as “dawn into darkness.”
